Name: Pierre Sells Wild Seeds (Hidden Seed Spots)
Author: UncleArya
Description:
[size=3]This simple mod adds the 4 new wild seeds for sale at Pierre's.

Each seed type can only be purchased in their respective growing season.

[b]Progression Mode (Optional)[/b]

If enabled, you must [b]ship 50 (or a custom amount) of each crop[/b] grown from wild seeds before the wild seeds become available for purchase from Pierre. To increase this number, simply enter your desired amount in the configs via GMCM.

Progression Mode is [b]disabled by default[/b], allowing for the purchase of wild seeds immediately.

[b]Default Seed Prices:
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Carrot: 30g[/size]
[*][size=3]Summer Squash: 50g[/size]
[*][size=3]Broccoli: 60g[/size]
[*][size=3]Powdermelon: 30g[/size]
[/list][size=3]Seed prices are configurable via GMCM.

[/size][size=3][b]Compatibility/Requirements:
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Can be added/removed from a save at any time[/size]
[*][size=3]Doesn't change crop behaviour or sell prices[/size]
